comparison.objective: Move an untaped-bottom carton of cans to a shelf without losing contents; candidate sifts ceramic media out while deliberately retaining washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous underside support of a failure-prone carton during transport versus controlled bimanual tilting/agitation that induces selective passage while retaining larger rings.
comparison.success_condition: All cans remain in the carton and the carton is stably released on the shelf versus ≥98% media in the receiver, all washers in the screen, no spill, screen reseated and 3-second release dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: The shared loose-content retention primitive is secondary: one tests supported transport with zero loss, while the candidate tests intentional selective discharge through real apertures.
